title: Xin hãy giúp tôi ra khỏi đây
englishTitle: Please help me get out of here
pronunciation: Xin hay giup toi ra khoi day
summary: For asking someone to help you leave an unsafe, confusing, or overwhelming place immediately.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Say it to staff, a driver, a guard, hotel help, or another trusted person while moving toward a safer exit.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Do not explain everything first. Name the need, point toward the door, street, desk, or safer area, and move.

phrases.vietnamese: Xin hãy giúp tôi ra khỏi đây
phrases.english: Please help me get out of here
phrases.pronunciation: Xin hay giup toi ra khoi day

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Xin hãy giúp means please help; tôi ra khỏi đây means me get out of here.

breakdown.vietnamese: Xin hãy giúp tôi ra khỏi đây
breakdown.english: Please help me get out of here

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Police, ambulance, and passport cards help when the situation needs official help.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good when a bar, room, vehicle, crowd, alley, or building no longer feels safe or manageable.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If someone is blocking you or following you, switch to police, help, or emergency phrases as soon as you can.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Unsafe, emergency, help, hospital, and passport cards cover the next safety step.
